a: Agba issur nichse, afillu meitzterovle derechayim. amar rav ashe: ki havenan be rav kahana, magbenan afillu meamla devatte.

Mishna hammocher et hechatzer – machar battim, borot, shichin umearot; aval lo et hammittaltelin. bizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma shebbetocho" – hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach – lo machar lo et hammerchatz, velo et bet habbad shebbetochah. rabbi eliezer omer: hammocher et hechatzer – lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammocher et hechatzer – machar battim hachitzonim, uvattim happenimim, uvet hacholsaot. chanuyot petuchot letochah – nimkarot immah, vesheen petuchot letochah – en nimkarot immah. petuchot lechan ulechan – [ellu] veellu nimkarot immah. rabbi eliezer omer: hammocher et hechatzer – lo machar ella milusa shel chatzer.
Amar mar: petuchot lechan ulechan – nimkarot immah. veha tane rabbi chiyyay: en nimkarot immah! la kashya; ha derov tashmishtayyhu lego, ha derov tashmishtayyhu levar.

Rabbi eliezer omer: hammocher et hechatzer – lo machar ella avirah shel chatzer. amar rabba: i daamar leh: "derta" – dechulle alma la peligi devatte mashma. ki peligi – daamar leh: "darta"; mar savar: tarbitza mashma, umar savar: batte mashma.
Ikka deamri, amar rabba: i daamar leh "darta" – dechulle alma la peligi devatte mashma. ki peligi, daamar leh: "chatzer"; mar savar: chatzer – avvera mashma, umar savar: kachatzar hammishkan.

Veamar rabba amar rav nachman: machar lo cholsit umetzula; hechzik bacholsit – lo kana metzula, hechzik bammetzula – lo kana cholsit. ini?! veha amar shemuel: machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot, kevan shehechzik beachat mehen – kana kullan!
Hatam hu desaddana deara chad hu, vechulla chada tashmishta hu; aval hacha – ha tashmishta lechod, veha tashmishta lechod.
Veikka deamri,
b: Amar rabba amar rav nachman: hechzik bacholsit – kana metzula. peshita – deha amar shemuel: machar lo eser sadot vechulei! mahu detema: hatam hu desaddana deara chad hu, aval hacha – ha tashmishta lechod, veha tashmishta lechod; ka mashma lan.

Mishna hammocher bet habbad – machar et hayyam veet hammemel veet habbetulot, aval lo machar et haavirim veet haggalgal veet hakkora. uvizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma shebbetocho" – hare kullan mechurin. rabbi eliezer omer: hammocher bet habbad – machar et hakkora.

Gemara "yam" – telafcha. "memel" – amar rabbi abba bar memel: mafrachta. "betulot" – amar rabbi yochanan: kelonsot shel erez, shemmaamidin bahen et hakkora. "avirim" – kivshe. "galgal" – chumarta. "kora" – kora.

Tanu rabbanan: hammocher bet habbad – machar et [ha]nesarim, veet hayyekavim, veet hammafrechot, veet harechayim hattachtonot – aval lo haelyona. uvizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma shebbetocho" – hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach – lo machar lo et haavirim, velo et hassakkin, velo et hammartzufin.
Rabbi eliezer omer: hammocher bet habbad – machar et hakkora, shello nikra bet habbad ella al shum kora.

Mishna hammocher et hammerchatz – lo machar et hannesarin, veet hassefalin, veet habbelaniyyot. bizman sheamar lo: "hi vechol ma shebbetochah" – hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach – lo machar lo et hammegurot shel mayim, velo et otzarot shel etzim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammocher et hammerchatz – machar et bet hannesarin, veet bet hayyekamin, veet bet hassefalim, veet bet havvilaot; aval lo et nesarin atzman, velo yekamin atzman, velo sefalim atzman, velo vilaot atzman. uvizman sheamar lo: "hi vechol ma shebbetochah" – hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach, lo machar lo et habberechot hamesappekot lo mayim – ben

a: Bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim, velo bet kinnus haetzim. veim amar lo: "bet hammerchatz vechol tashmishav ani mocher lach" – kullan mechurin.
Hahu daamar leh lechavreh: "bet habbad vechol tashmishav ani mocher lach". havaya hanhu chanvata abbaray, dahavo shatchu behu shumeshme. ata lekammeh derav yosef,

Amar leh: tenena, im amar: "bet hammerchatz vechol tashmishav ani mocher lach" – hare kullan mechurin. amar leh abbaye, veha tane rabbi chiyyay: en kullan mechurin! ella amar rav ashe: chazenan – i amar leh: "bet habbad vechol tashmishav, veillen mitzranaha" – kane, vei la – la kane.

Mishna hammocher et hair – machar battim; borot, shichin umearot; merchatzaot veshovachot; bet habbaddin uvet hashshelachin; aval lo et hammittaltelin. uvizman sheamar lo: "hi vechol ma shebbetochah" – afillu hayu bah behema vaavadim, hare kullan mechurin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hammocher et hair – machar et hassanter.
Gemara amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: shamat minna, avda kemittaltela dame; dei kimkarka dame, nizdabban aggav mata! veella may, avda kemittaltela dame?! may afillu?
Ella may it lach lememar – shane ben mittaltela denayed mimmittaltela dela nayed; afillu tema avda kimkarka dame – shane ben mekarka denayed, limkarka dela nayed.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hammocher et hair – machar et hassanter. may "santer"? hacha targimu: bar machvonita. shimon ben avtulemos omer: bage. man deamar bar machvonita – kol shekken bage; man deamar bage – aval bar machvonita la mizdabban.

Tenan: bet habbaddim uvet hashshelachin. savruha, may "shelachin" – bage, dichtiv: "vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot"; bishlama leman deamar bar machvonita – amar tanna kamma: bage mizdabbeni, bar machvonita la mizdabban; vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar: afillu bar machvonita name mizdabban. ella leman deamar bage – tanna kamma name hachi kaamar!

Mi savrat may "shelachin" – bage?! la; may "shelachin" – ginuneyayta, shenneemar: "shelachayich pardes rimmonim"; aval bage – la mizdabbeni. vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar: afillu bage name mizdabbeni.

Ikka deamri: savruha, may "shelachin" – ginuneyata; bishlama leman deamar bage – amar tanna kamma: genunayyata mizdabban, bage la mizdabbeni; vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar: afillu bage mizdabbeni.
b: Ella leman deamar bar machvonita – amar tanna kamma: ginuneyayta; umahdar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel: bar machvonita?! mi savrat may "shelachin" – ginuneyayta?! la; may "shelachin" – bage, dichtiv: "vesholeach mayim al pene chutzot"; aval bar machvonita – la mizdabban. vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar, daafillu bar machvonita name mizdabban.
Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: santer eno machur, ankulemus machur. may, lav middeankulemus gavra, santer name gavra? midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita.

Umi matzet amrat hachi? veha katane sefa: aval lo sheyayreha velo benoteha, velo chorashin hammuketzin lah, velo bevarin shel chayya veshel ofot veshel dagim. veamrinan: may "sheyayreha"? bizle. may bizle? amar rabbi abba: piske bage. piske bage hu dela mizdabbeni, ha bage atzman – mizdabbeni!
Efoch – rabbi yehuda omer: santer – machur, ankulemos – eno machur.

Umi matzet amrat rabbi yehuda – kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh? veha rabbi yehuda kerabbanan sevira leh! dekatane sefa: aval lo sheyayreha velo benoteha. veillu rabban shimon ben gamliel, haamar: machar et hair – machar benoteha! detanya: hammocher et hair – la machar et benoteha. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hammocher et hair – machar benoteha!
Rabbi yehuda savar leh kevoteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.

Velo bevarin shel chayya veshel ofot veshel dagim. ureminhi: hayu lah banot – en nimkarot immah. haya lah chelek echad bayyam vechelek echad bayyabbasha; bevarim shel chayya veshel ofot veshel dagim – hare ellu nimkarim immah!
La kashya; ha dingiach kayhi legav, veha dingiach kayhi levar. veha ka tane: velo et chorashin hammuketzin lah! ema: hammuketzin hemenna.

Mishna hammocher et hassade – machar et haavanim shehem letzorkah, veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehem letzorko, veet hattevua shehi mechubberet lakkarka, veet chitzat hakkanim shehi pechuta mibbet rova, veet hashshomera sheenah asuya betit, veet hecharuv sheeno murekav, veet betulat hashshikma.

Aval lo machar lo et haavanim sheenan letzorkah, velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzorko, velo et hattevua shehi telusha min hakkarka. bizman sheamar lo: "hi vechol ma shebbetochah" – hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach – lo machar lo et chitzat hakkanim shehi bet rova, velo et hashshomera shehi asuya betit, velo et hecharuv hammurekav, velo et saddan hashshikma.

a: Gemara may "avanim shehen letzorkah"? hacha targimu: avne deachpa. ulla amar: avanim hassedurot legader. veha tane rabbi chiyyay: avanim tzevurot legader! teni: "sedurot".
Hacha targimu avne deachpa; lerabbi meir – dimtakkenan, af al gav dela machatan; lerabbanan – hu demachatan.
Uleulla, deamar: avanim hassedurot legader; lerabbi meir – dimtakkenan, af al gav dela sediran; lerabbanan – hu disdiran.

Veet hakkanim shebbakkerem shehen letzorko. kanim may avidtayyhu? amri deve rabbi yannay: kanim hamechullakin shemmaamidim tachat haggefanim; lerabbi meir – dimshappeyayn, af al gav dela mokman; lerabbanan – hu demokman.
Veet hattevua hamechubberet lakkarka vechulei. veaf al gav dimtay lemichtzad. veet chitzat hakkanim sheppechuta mibbet rova. veaf al gav deallimi.
Veet hashshomera sheenah asuya betit. af al gav dela kevia beara. veet hecharuv sheeno murekav, veet betulat hashshikma. af al gav deallimi.
Aval lo machar et haavanim sheenan letzorkah. lerabbi meir – dela metakkenan, lerabbanan – dela machatan.
Uleulla, deamar: avanim hassedurot legader; lerabbi meir – dela metakkenan, lerabbanan – dela sediran.
Velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan letzorko. lerabbi meir – dela meshappeyayn, lerabbanan – dela mokman. velo et hattevua hattelusha min hakkarka. veaf al gav ditzricha leara.

Velo et chitzat hakkanim shehi bet rova. veaf al gav dekattine. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo chitzat hakkanim bilvad; ella afillu aruga ketanna shel besamim, veyesh lah shem bifne atzmah – enah nimkeret immah. amar rav pappa: vehu dekaru lah: "vavrda diflanya".
Velo hashshomera haasuya betit. veaf al gav dimchabbera beara. velo et charuv hammurekav, velo saddan hashshikma. veaf al gav dekattine.
Bae rabbi elazar: malbenot shel petachim, mahu? hecha dimchabberi betina – la tibbee lach, deha mechabbar; ki tibbee lach – dinkiti besikke; may? teku.
Bae rabbi zera: malbenot shel challonot, mahu? mi amrinan: lenoy bealma hu daavidi; o dilma, kevan dimchabberi – mechabberi? teku.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: malbenot shel kare hammitta, mahu? kol hecha demittaltele bahada – la tibbee lach, deha mittalteli; ki tibbee lach – hecha dela mittalteli; may? teku.
Velo et charuv hammurekav, velo saddan hashshikma vechulei.
b: Mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav, deamar kera: "vayyakom sede efron asher bammachpela vegomer" – mi shetztzarich ligvul saviv. yatzu ellu, sheen tzerichin ligvul saviv. amar rav mesharsheya: mikkan limtzarim min hattora.

Amar rav yehuda: hay man dimzabben ara lechavreh, tzarich lemichtav leh: "keni lach diklin vetalin vehutzin vetzitzin". veaf al gav dechi la ketav leh hachi – kene, afillu hachi – shufera dishtara hu.
Amar leh: "ara vedikle" – chazenan; i it leh dikle – yahev leh tere dikle, vei let leh – zaven leh tere dikle, vei meshabedi – parek leh tere dikle.

"Ara bedikle" – chazenan; i it ba dikle – yahev leh, vei lav – mikkach taut hu. "ara be dikle" – let leh dikle, dechazya ledikle kaamar leh. amar leh levar middikla pelanya – chazenan; i dikla tava hu – shayyore shayyeyreh, i dikla bisha hu – kol shekken hanach.
Amar leh levar meilane – i it leh ilane, levar meilane. i it leh dikle – levar middikle. i it leh gufene – levar miggufene.
Ilane vegufene – levar meilane. ilane vedikle – levar meilane. gufene vedikle – levar miggufene.
Amar rav: kol sheolin lo bechevel – have shiyyur, kol sheen olin lo bechevel – la have shiyyur.

a: Vedayyayne gola amri: kol shehaol kovsho – la have shiyyur, kol sheen haol kovsho – have shiyyur. vela peligi – ha bedikle, ha beilane.

Bea minneh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet: "chutz mecharuv peloni", "chutz missaddan peloni", mahu? oto charuv hu dela kane, ha shear charuvim kane; o dilma, shear charuvin name la kane? amar leh: lo kana.
Etiveh: "chutz mecharuv peloni", "chutz missaddan peloni" – lo kana! may, lav oto charuv hu delo kana, ha shear charuvin kana?
Amar leh: la; afillu shear charuvin name lo kana. teda – deillu amar leh: "sadi mechura lach chutz missade pelonit" – hahi hu dela kane, ha achranyayta kane?! ella la kana; hacha name, lo kana.

Veikka deamri: bea minneh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet: "chutz mechatzi charuv peloni", "chutz mechatzi saddan peloni", mahu? shear charuvin vadday la kane, ha ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv – kane; o dilma, afillu ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv name la kane? amar leh: la kane.
Etiveh: "chutz mechatzi charuv peloni", "chutz mechatzi saddan peloni" – shear charuvin lo kana. may, lav shear charuvin hu dela kana, ha ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv – kana?

Amar leh: la; afillu ma sheshshiyyer beoto charuv name lo kana. teda, deillu amar leh: "sadi mechura lach chutz mechatzi sade peloni" – hahu hu dela kana, ha iddach kana?! ella la kane; hacha name – la kane.

Bea minneh rav amram merav chisda: hammafkid etzel chavero bishtar, veamar lo: "hechzartim lach", mahu? mi amrinan: miggo dei bae amar "neensu" – meheman, hasheta name meheman; o dilma, amar leh: "shetarach bidi may bae"? amar leh: meheman.
Velema leh: "shetarach bidi may bae"! amar leh: velitamaych, vechi amar leh "neensu" – mi matze amar leh: "shetarach bidi may bae"?! amar leh:
b: Sof sof, ki amar leh "neensu", lav shevua bae? hacha name, may "neeman" – neeman bishvua.
Lema biflugeta dehane tannae – detanya: shetar kis hayyotze al hayyetomim – dayyayne gola amri: nishba vegove kullo. vedayyayne eretz yisrael amri: nishba vegove mechetza.
Udechulle alma it lehu dinhardae – deamri nehardae: hay iska – palga milve, ufalga pikkadon.
May, lav beha ka mippalgi – demar savar, matze amar leh: "shetarach bidi may bae"; umar savar, la amri?
La; dechulle alma it lehu derav chisda; vehacha beha kamippalgi – demar savar: im ita defareh, memar hava amar. umar savar: emor malach hammavet hu deanseh.
Shelach rav huna bar avin: hammafkid etzel chavero bishtar, veamar lo: "hechzartiv lach" – neeman. ushetar kis hayyotze al hayyetomin – nishba vegove kullo.
Tarte?! shane hatam, deim ita defareh – memar hava amar.
Rava amar: hilcheta – nishba vegove mechetza. amar mar zutera: hilcheta kedayyayne gola. amar leh ravina lemar zutera, ha amar rava: nishba vegove mechetza! amar leh: anan, dedayyayne gola

a: Ippecha matninan la.
Mishna lo et habbor velo et haggat velo et hashshovach – ben charevin, ben yeshuvin. vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich.

Umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo: "chutz meellu", sheeno tzarich likkach lo derech. mecharan leacher – rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich likkach lo derech, vachachamim omrim: tzarich likkach lo derech.
Bamme devarim amurim – bemocher, aval benoten mattana – noten et kullah. haachin shechalku, zachu bassade – zachu bechullah. hammachazik benichse hagger, hechzik bassade – hechzik bechullah.
Hammakdish et hassade – hikdish et kullah. rabbi shimon omer: hammakdish et hassade – lo hikdish ella et hecharuv hammurekav, veet saddan hashshikma.
Gemara may shena mecher umay shena mattana? peresh yehuda ben nekosa lifne rabbi: ze peresh veze lo peresh.
Hay "ze peresh veze lo peresh"?! ze lo peresh veze lo peresh hu! ella ze haya lo lefaresh, veze lo haya lo lefaresh.
Hahu daamar lehu: "havu leh liflanya beta, demachzik mea gulefe". ishtechach dahava machzik mea veesrin, amar mar zutera: mea amar leh, mea veesrin la amar leh.
Rav ashe amar, mi la tenan: bamme devarim amurim – bemocher, aval benoten mattana – noten et kullan? alma man deyahev mattana – beayin yafa yahev; hacha name, man deyahev mattana – beayin yafa yahev.

Hammakdish et hassade – hikdish vechulei. amar rav huna, af al gav daamur rabbanan: hakkone shene ilanot betoch shel chavero – hare ze lo kana karka, machar karka veshiyyer shene ilanot lefanav – yesh lo karka. vaafillu lerabbi akiva, deamar: mocher beayin yafa mocher – hane mille gabbe bor vadut, dela ka machchashi beara; aval ilanot, deka machchashi beara –
b: Im ita dela shayyayr, lema leh: "akor ilanach, shekol vezil".
Tenan, rabbi shimon omer: hammakdish et hassade – lo hikdish ella charuv hammurekav, vesaddan hashshikma. vetane ala: "amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? hoil veyonkin missede hekdesh".
Vei salka datach shayyore shayyayr, ki ka yanki – middenafsheh ka yanki!
Rabbi shimon deamar – kerabbi akiva. verav huna deamar – kerabbanan.
Kerabbanan?! peshita! nafka minna – dei nafli, hadar shatel lehu.

a: Umi matzet mokmat la lerabbi shimon kerabbi akiva? veha tanya: hikdish shelosha ilanot mimmatta asara levet sea – hare hikdish et hakkarka veet hailanot shebbenehem; lefichach keshehu pode – pode bet zera chomer seorim, bachamishshim shekel kasef.

Pachot mikkan o yoter al ken, o shehikdishan baze achar ze – hare ze lo hikdish lo hakkarka, velo et hailanot shebbenehem. lefichach, keshehu pode – pode et hailanot beshovvyehen. velo od, ella afillu hikdish et hailanot, vechazar vehikdish et hakkarka; keshehu pode – pode et hailanot beshovvyehen, vechozer ufode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef.
Manni? i rabbi akiva, ha amar: mocher beayin yafa mocher; vechol shekken makdish! i rabbanan, ha amri: mocher hu divayin raa mocher, aval makdish – beayin yafa makdish! ella peshita rabbi shimon hi,

Verabbi shimon – allibba deman? i allibba derabbi akiva, ha amar: mocher beayin yafa mocher; vechol shekken makdish! ella peshita allibba derabbanan, veka savar rabbi shimon: ki hechi democher beayin raa mocher, makdish name beayin raa makdish – umeshayyayr ara.
b: Veella kashya "hoil veyonkin missede hekdesh"!

Ella rabbi shimon – ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu: ledidi, ki hechi democher beayin raa mocher, makdish name beayin raa makdish – veshayyore meshayyayr; ledidchu, odu li miha delo hikdish ella charuv hammurekav vesaddan hashshikma! veamri leh rabbanan: la shena.

Bemay okemta la – kerabbi shimon? ema sefa: velo od, ella afillu hikdish et hailanot vechazar vehikdish et hakkarka, keshehu pode – pode et hailanot beshovyehen, vechozer ufode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef.
Vei rabbi shimon – lezil batar pidyon, venipparku aggav arayyhu – deha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deazel batar pidyon!

Detanya: minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah, veachar kach met aviv – minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza? talmud lomar: "veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" – sade sheen reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo – sheruya lihyot sede achuzza; divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon.

Rabbi meir omer: minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv, umet aviv veachar kach hikdish, minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza? talmud lomar: "veim et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" – sade sheenah sede achuzza, yatzta zo – shehi sede achuzza.
Veillu rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon, hecha demet aviv veachar kach hikdishah – la tzerichi kera; ki itzterich kera – hecha dehikdishah veachar kach met aviv.
Mena lehu? i mehay kera, ema lechidrabbi meir hu daata! ella lav mishshum deazli batar pidyon?

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: leolam bealma – rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon la azli batar pidyon; vehacha, kera ashkachu uderush – im ken, lichtov kera: "veim et sede miknato asher lo achuzzato", i name "sede achuzzato", may "asher lo missede achuzzato"? et sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo – sheruya lihyot sede achuzza.

Amar rav huna: charuv hammurekav vesaddan hashshikma – torat ilan alav, vetorat karka alav. torat ilan alav, dehecha deakdesh o zabben shene ilanot vehay – yesh lo karka. torat karka alav, dela mizdabban aggav ara.
Veamar rav huna: omer sheyyesh bo satayim – torat omer alav vetorat gadish alav. torat omer alav, dishne omarim – shichcha, shenayim vahu – enan shichcha.
Torat gadish alav, ditnan: omer sheyyesh bo satayim, shechacho – en shichcha.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: charuv hammurekav vesaddan hashshikma – banu lemachloket rabbi menachem bar yose verabbanan.

a: Velema machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan! ha ka mashma lan – derabbi menachem berabbi yose kerabbi shimon sevira leh.
Haderan alach hammocher et habbayit

Hammocher et hassefina – machar et hattoren veet hannes veet haogin, veet kol hammanhigin otah. aval lo machar lo et haavadim, velo et hammartzufin, velo et haantike. uvizman sheamar lo: "hi vechol ma shebbetochah" – hare kullan mechurin.

Gemara "toren" – iskarya. vechen hu omer: "erez millevanon lakachu laasot toren alayich". "nes" – adra. vechen hu omer: "shesh berikma mimmitzrayim haya mifrasech lihyot lach lenes". "ogin" – tane rabbi chiyyay: ellu oginin shellah. vechen hu omer: "halahen tesabberna ad asher yigdalu, halahen teagena levilti heyot leish.
"Manhigin" – amar rabbi abba: ellu hammeshotin shellah. vechen hu omer: "allonim mibbashan asu mishshotayich". vei baet ema, mehacha: "veyardu meoniyyotehem kol tofse mashot".

Tanu rabbanan: hammocher et hassefina – machar et haiskala, veet bor hammayim shebbetochah. rabbi natan omer: hammocher et hassefina – machar et habbitztzit. somchos omer: hammocher et hassefina – machar et haddugit.

Amar rava: bitztzit hayeynu dugit. rabbi natan – bavlaa hava, kare la: "butztzit" – kidamri inashe: butztziyata demeshan. somchos – devar eretz yisrael, kare la: "dugit", kedichtiv: "veacharitchen besirot duga".

Amar rabba, ishtau li nachote yamma: hay galla dimtabba lisfina – mitchaze ki tzutzita denura chiuorta beresha, umachenan leh bealvota dachakik aleh – "ehye asher ehye yah Adonai tzevaot amen amen sela", venayaych.

Amar rabba, ishtau li nachote yamma: ben galla legalla telat mea parse, veruma degalla telat mea parse. zimna chada hava azlinan beorcha, vedallinan galla ad dachazenan be marbateh dechochva zuta, vehaveya li kemivzar arbein gerive bizra dechardela. vei dallinan tefe – hava mikkelenan mehaveleh.

Verame la galla kala lachaverta: "chaverti, shevakt midde bealma dela shetafteh, denete ana uneabbede?" amar leh: "pok chazi gevureta demarich, mela chuta chala – vela avari, shenneemar: 'haoti lo tirau neum Adonai, im mippanay lo tachilu asher samti chol gevul layyam, chok olam velo yaavrenhu".

Amar rabba: ledidi chaze li huremin bar lilit, ki ka rahet akkufeya deshura demachoza, verahet parasha ki rechiv chevta mittattaeh, vela yachel leh. zimna chada hava mesargan leh tarte kudanyayte, vekayyman
b: Attere gishre derognag; veshavar mehay lehay umehay lehay, venaket tere mizge dechamra bideh, umorik mehay lehay umehay lehay, vela natfa nittufeta leara; veoto hayyom "yaalu shamayim yerdu tehomot" hava. ad dishmau be malchuta, vekatluhu.

Amar rabba: ledidi chaze li urezila bar yomeh, dahava kehar tavor. vehar tavor kamma have? arba parse. umeshacha detzavvereh telata parse, uve marbata deresheh parsa ufalga. rema kufeta, usechar leh leyardena.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chazya li hahi akruketa, dehavya ki akra dehagruneya. veakra dehagruneya kamma havya? shittin batte. ata tannina bala. ata pushekantza uvala letannina, uselek yetev beilana. ta chazi kamma nefish cheleh deilana. amar rav pappa bar shemuel: i la havay hatam, la hemani.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bisfinta, vachazenan hahu kavvra deyatva leh achla tina beuseyeh, veadchuhu mayya veshadyuhu legudda, vacharuv minneh shittin machoze. vaachul minneh shittin machoze, umelachu minneh shittin machoze, umalliu mechad gilgela deeneh telat mea garve mishcha. vechi hadaran levatar teresar yarche shatta, chazenan dahava ka menasseri miggarmeh metallelata, veyatvi lemivninhu hanach machoze.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bisfinta, vachazenan hahu kevora deyatva leh chalta aggabbeh vekadach agma illaveh. savrinan yabbeshta hi, uselekinan vaafenan uvashshelinan aggabbeh. vechad cham gabbeh ithafich, vei lav dahava mekarva sefinta, hava tavinan.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava azlinan bisfinta, usegay sefinta ben shitza leshitza dichvara telata yome utelata lelavota, ihu bizkifa vaanan beshippula. vechi tema: la mesaggeya sefinta tuva, ki ata rav dimi amar: kemecham kumekuma demayya mesaggeya shittin parse, veshade parasha gira – vekadma leh. veamar rav ashe: hahu gildana deyamma hu, deit leh tere shiytze.

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava azlinan bisfinta, vachazenan hahu tzippera dekaem ad kartzuleh bemayya, veresheh birkia. veamrinan lekka mayya, uvaenan lechut leikkore nafshin; unefak bat kala veamar lan: "la techutu hacha, dinfalat leh chatzitza levar naggara ha shav shene, vela ka matya aara". velav mishshum dinfishi mayya, ella mishshum dirdifi mayya. amar rav ashe: vehahu ziz saday hu, dichtiv: "veziz saday immadi".

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bemadbera, vachazenan hanhu avoze deshamti gadfayyhu mishshumnayyhu, veka nagdi nachale demishcha mittutayyhu. amena lehu: it lan begavvayychu chulaka lealma deate? chada deli gadpa, vachada deli atma. ki atay lekammeh derabbi elazar, amar li: atidin yisrael litten alehen et haddin.
(Siman: keafra ditchelta terakteh akrabba lesilteh)

Veamar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bemadbera, veitlavvi bahadan hahu tayyaya dahava shakel afra umorach leh, veamar: ha orcha leducheta pelan, veha orcha leducheta pelan. amrinan leh: kamma merachakinan mimmayya? veamar lan: havu li afra. yahavinan leh, veamar lan: tamne parse. tanenan veyahavinan leh, amar lan dimrachakinan telata parse. afachit leh, vela yechelit leh.
Amar li: ta achave lach mete midbar. azali, chazitinhu vedamu keman demibbassemi,

a: Veganu apparkid. vahava zekifa birkeh dechad minnayyhu, veayel tayyaya tute birkeh ki rechiv gamla, uzekifa rumecheh vela naga beh. pesaki chada karna ditchelta dechad minnayyhu, vela hava mistaggi lan. amar li: dilma shekalt midde minnayyhu? ahdereh, digmiri deman deshakel midde minnayyhu la mistaggi leh. azali ahdarteh, vahadar mistaggi lan.

Ki atay lekammeh derabbanan, amaru li: kol "abba" – chamra, vechol "bar bar chana" – sichsa! lemay hilcheta avadt hachi? lemidda i kevet shammay i kevet hillel? ibbei lach lemimne chutin ulemimne chuleyot.
Amar li: ta achve lach har sinay. azali, chazay dehadra leh akrabba, vekayyma ki chamare chivorati. shamati bat kol sheomeret: "oy li shennishbati; veachshav shennishbati – mi mefer li?"
Ki atay lekammeh derabbanan, amaru li: kol "abba" – chamra, kol "bar bar chana" – sichsa! haya lecha lomar "mufar lach"! vehu savar: dilma shevuata demabbul hu. verabbanan – im ken, "oy li" lamma?

Amar li: ta achve lach belue dekorach. chazay tere bize, vahavo ka mappeki kutera. shekal gevava deamra veamshinne bemayya, vedaatzite bereshe derumecha veayyeyleh hatam, vechi appek, hava icharach icharoche. amar li: atztzet may shamat, ushemait dahavo amrin: "moshe vetorato emet, vehen baddain". amar li: kol telatin yome mahdar lehu gehinnam lehacha kevasar bekallachat, veamri hachi: "moshe vetorato emet, vehen baddain".

Amar li: ta achve lach hecha denashki ara urekia ahadade. shekalta lesiltay, atnachta bechavvevta dirkia. addimtzallena, beeteh vela ashkachte. amena leh: ikka gannave hacha? amar li: hay gilgela dirkia hava dehadar, netar ad limchar hacha – umashkachat la.

Rabbi yochanan mishtae: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bisfinta; vachazenan hahu kevora deappekeh leresheh miyyamma, vedamyayn ayyneh kitre sehare; unefutz mayya mittarte zimeh kitre mabbare desura. rav safra mishtae: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bisfinta; vachazenan hahu kevora deappekeh leresheh miyyamma, vahava leh karne vachakik alay: "ana beriyya kalla shebbayyam"; vahavena telat mea parse, veazelna lefumma delivyatan. amar rav ashe: hahu izza deyamma hu, devachisha veit la karne.
Rabbi yochanan mishtae: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bisfinta; vachazenan hahi kartelita, dahavo ka mekabbei ba avanim tovot umargaliyyot, vehadri la mine dichvore demikkere karsha. nechet
b: Bar amoray leetuya, uregash uvae lishmeteh leatmeh, usheda zika dechalla unechet. nefak bat kala amar lan: "may it lechu bahade kartelita didvethu derabbi chanina ben dosa, daatida deshadya techelta bah letzaddike lealma deate!"

Rav yehuda hindeva mishtae: zimna chada hava azlinan bisfinta, vachazenan hahu even tava dahava hadayr la tannina. nachet bar amorae leetuya, ata tannina ka bae lemivla la lisfinta. ata pishkantza paskeh leresheh, ithafichu mayya vahavo dema. ata tannina chavreh, shakla vetalya leh vachaya. hadar ata ka bae bala lisfinta, hadar ata tzippera paskeh leresheh. shakluha lehahi even tava shadyuha lisfinta; hava hane tzippere melichi bahadan, otvinhu alayyhu; shakluha uferachu lehu bahada.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua shehayu bain bisfina, vehaya rabbi eliezer yashen verabbi yehoshua neor. nizdaza rabbi yehoshua, veninar rabbi eliezer. amar lo: ma ze yehoshua, mippene ma nizdazata? amar lo: maor gadol raiti bayyam. amar lo: shemma enav shel livyatan raita – dichtiv: "enav keafappe shachar".

Amar rav ashe, amar li huna bar natan: zimna chada hava ka azlinan bemadbera, vahavay atma devisra bahadan. petachna, venakkayrna, veannachna aisve. addemayytinan tzive, chalam atma, utevenan. ki hadaran levatar teresar yarche shatta, chazenhu lehanhu gumere dahavo ka melachashi. ki atay lekammeh deammemar, amar li: hahu isba samtari hava; hanhu gumere deritma havo.

"Vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim" – hacha targimu: urzile deyamma. rabbi yochanan amar: ze livyatan nachash bariach velivyatan nachash akallaton, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yifkod Adonai becharbo hakkasha vegomer".

(Siman: kol, shaa, yarden) amar rav: yehuda amar rav: kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo – zachar unekeva beraam. af livyatan nachash bariach velivyatan nachash akallaton – zachar unekeva beraam, veilmale nizkakin ze laze – machrivin kol haolam kullo. ma asa hakkadosh baruch hu? seras et hazzachar, veharag hannekeva umelachah latztzaddikim leatid lavo, shenneemar: "veharag et hattannin asher bayyam".

Veaf behemot beharere elef – zachar unekeva beraam, veilmale nizkakin ze laze macharivin kol haolam kullo. ma asa hakkadosh baruch hu? seras hazzachar, vetzinnen hannekeva ushemarah latztzaddikim leatid lavo, shenneemar: "hinne na chocho vemotnav" – ze zachar, "veono bishrire vitno" – zo nekeva.

Hatam name, lisarseh lezachar velitzannenna linkeva! dagim peritzi. velebed ippecha! ibbaet ema: nekeva melicha mealle; ibbaet ema, kevan dichtiv: "livyatan ze yatzarta lesachek bo", bahade nekeva lav orach ara. hacha name, limlecha linkeva! kevora melicha mealle, bisra melicha la mealle.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa shebbikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu livroot et haolam, amar lo lesar shel yam: petach picha uvela kol memot shebbaolam. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, day sheemod beshelli. miyyad baat bo vaharago, shenneemar: "bechocho raga hayyam uvitvunato machatz rahav".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: shema minna, saro shel yam "rahav" shemo; veilmale mayim mechassin oto – en kol beriyya yechola laamod berecho, shenneemar: "lo yareu velo yashchitu bechol har kodshi vegomer, kammayim layyam mechassim" – al tikre "layyam mechassim", ella "lesarah shel yam mechassim".

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: yarden – yotze mimmearat pamyays. tanya name hachi: yarden yotze mimmearat pamyays, umehallech beyammah shel sivchi uveyammah shel teverya, umitgalgel veyored layyam haggadol; umitgalgel veyored ad shemmaggia lefiv shel livyatan, shenneemar: "yivtach ki yagiach yarden el pihu". matkef la rava bar ulla: hay bivhemot beharere elef ketiv! ella amar rava bar ulla: ematay behemot beharere elef betuchot? bizman shemmegiach yarden befiv shel livyatan.

(Siman: yamim, gavriel, raav) ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "ki hu al yammim yesadah veal neharot yechonneha"? ellu shiva yamim vearbaa neharot shemmakkifin et eretz yisrael. veellu hen shiva yamim: yammah shel teverya, veyammah shel sedom, veyammah shel chelat, veyammah shel chelata, veyammah shel sivchi, veyam aspamya, veyam haggadol. veellu hen arbaa neharot: yarden, veyarmuch, vekerumeyon, ufega.
Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yonatan: atid gavriel laasot

a: Kenigya im livyatan, shenneemar: "hattimshoch livyatan bechakka uvechevel tashkia leshono", veilmale hakkadosh baruch hu ozro – en yachol lo; shenneemar: "haoso yaggesh charbo".

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: beshaa shellivyatan raev, motzi hevel mippiv umartiach kol memot shebbammetzula – shenneemar: "yartiach kassir metzula". veilmale machnis rosho legan eden – en kol beriyya yechola laamod berecho, shenneemar: "yam yasim kemerkacha".

Uveshaa shetztzame – ose telamim telamim bayyam, shenneemar: "acharav yair nativ". amar rav acha bar yaakov: en tehom chozer leetano ad shivim shana, shenneemar: "yachshov tehom leseva" – veen "seva" pechuta mishshivim.

Amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: atid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot seuda latztzaddikim mibbesaro shel livyatan, shenneemar: "yichru alav chabbarim"; veen "kera" ella seuda – shenneemar: "vayyichre lahem kera gedola vayyochlu vayyishtu"; veen "chaverim" ella talmide chachamim – shenneemar: "hayyoshevet baggannim, chaverim makshivim lekolech, hashemiini".

Vehashshear – mechallekin oto, veosin bo sechora beshuke yerushalayim – shenneemar: "yechetzuhu ben kenaanim"; veen "kenaanim" ella taggarim – shenneemar: "kenaan beyado mozne mirma laashok ahev". vei baet ema, mehacha: "asher sochareha sarim, kinaneha nichbadde aretz".

Veamar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: atid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot sukka latztzaddikim meoro shel livyatan, shenneemar: "hatemalle vesukkot oro". zacha – osin lo sukka, lo zacha – osin lo tziltzal; shenneemar: "uvetziltzal dagim rosho".
Zacha – osin lo tziltzal, lo zacha – osin lo anak; shenneemar: "vaanakim legargerotecha". zacha – osin lo anak, lo zacha – osin lo kamea; shenneemar: "vetiksherennu lenaarotecha".
Vehashshear – porso hakkadosh baruch hu al chomot yerushalayim, vezivo mavhik missof haolam vead sofo, shenneemar: "vehalchu goyim leorech, umelachim lenoga zarchech".

"Vesamti kadchod shimshotayich" – amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: peligi tere malache birkia – gavriel umichael; veamri la tere amorae bemareva, uman innun – yehuda vechizkiyya bene rabbi chiyyay; chad amar: shoham, vechad amar: yashfe. amar lehu hakkadosh baruch hu: leheve keden ucheden.

"Ushearayich leavne ekdach" – ki ha deyatev rabbi yochanan veka daresh: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehavi avanim tovot umargaliyyot shehem sheloshim al sheloshim, vechokek bahen eser al esrim, umaamidan beshaare yerushalayim. ligleg alav oto talmid: hasheta keveata detzitzla la mashkechinan, kulle hay mashkechinan?!

Leyamim hifliga sefinato bayyam, chaza malache hashsharet deyatvi veka meynasseri avanim tovot umargaliyyot shehem sheloshim al sheloshim, vechakuk bahen eser berum esrim. amar lehu: hane leman? amaru leh: sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehaamidan beshaare yerushalayim. ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: derosh rabbi, lecha nae lidrosh, kaasher amarta ken raiti. amar lo: reka! ilmale lo raita – lo heemanta; melagleg al divre chachamim atta! natan enav bo, venaasa gal shel atzamot.
Metivi: "vaolech etchem kommiyyut" – rabbi meir omer: matayim amma, kishte komot shel adam harishon.

Rabbi yehuda omer: mea amma, keneged hechol uchetalav – shenneemar: "asher banenu kintiim meguddalim binurehem, benotenu chezaviyyot mechuttavot tavnit hechol"! ki kaamar rabbi yochanan – lechavvevy deve zika.

Veamar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: atid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot sheva chuppot lechol tzaddik vetzaddik, shenneemar: "uvara Adonai al kol mechon har tziyyon veal mikraeha anan yomam, veashan venoga esh lehava layla, ki al kol kavod chuppa" – melammed shekkol echad veechad ose lo hakkadosh baruch hu chuppa lefi kevodo.

Ashan bachuppa lamma? amar rabbi chanina: shekkol mi sheenav tzarot betalmide chachamim baolam hazze, mitmalleot enav ashan laolam habba. veesh bachuppa lamma? amar rabbi chanina: melammed shekkol echad veechad nichve mechuppato shel chavero. oy lah leotah busha, oy lah leotah kelima.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "venatatta mehodcha alav" – velo kol hodcha; zekenim shebbeoto haddor amru: pene moshe kifne chamma, pene yehoshua kifne levana; oy lah leotah busha, oy lah leotah kelimma.

Amar rabbi chama bar chanina: eser chuppot asa hakkadosh baruch hu leadam harishon began eden – shenneemar: "beeden gan elohim hayita, kol even yekara vegomer". mar zutera amar: achat esre, shenneemar: "kol even yekara". amar rabbi yochanan: vegarua shebbechullan – zahav, deka chashev leh levassof.

May "melechet tuppecha unekavecha bach"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lechiram melech tzor: "becha nistakkalti, uvarati nekavim nekavim baadam". veikka deamri, hachi kaamar: becha nistakkalti,
b: Vekanasti mita al adam harishon.

May "veal mikraeha"? amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: lo kirushalayim shel olam hazze yerushalayim shel olam habba; yerushalayim shel olam hazze – kol harotze laalot ole, shel olam habba – en olin ella hamezummanin lah.

Veamar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: atidin tzaddikim shennikrain al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ, yetzartiv af asitiv". veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha nikreu al shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, veellu hen: tzaddikim, umashiach, virushalaym.

Tzaddikim – ha daamaran. mashiach – dichtiv: "veze shemo asher yikreo Adonai tzidkenu". yerushalayim – dichtiv: "saviv shemona asar alef, veshem hair miyyom Adonai shamma", al tikre "shamma" ella "shemah". amar rabbi elazar: atidin tzaddikim sheomrim lifnehen "kadosh" – kederech sheomrim lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam, kadosh yeamer lo".

Veamar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehagebiah et yerushalayim shalosh parsaot lemala, shenneemar: "veraama veyashva tachteha"; may "tachteha" – ketachteha. umimmay dehay "tachteha" telata parse havya? amar rabba, amar li hahu sava: ledidi chaze li yerushalayim kammayyta, utelata parse havya.
Veshemma tomar: yesh tzaar laalot? talmud lomar: "mi elle kaav teufena, vechayyonim el arubbotehem". amar rav pappa: shema minna, hay eva – telata parse middele.
Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu latet et yerushalayim bemidda, shenneemar: "vaomar ana atta holech, vayyomer elay: lamod et yerushalam, lirot kamma rochbah vechamma orkah" –

Amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, harebe kerakkim barata beolamcha shel ummot haolam – velo natatta middat orkan umiddat rochban; yerushalayim – sheshshimcha betochah, umikdashcha betochah, vetzaddikim betochah – atta noten bah midda?! miyyad – "vayyomer elav, rutz dabber el hannaar hallaz lemor: perazot teshev yerushalam, merov adam uvehema betochah".

Amar resh lakish: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehosif al yerushelem elef tefef ginnoot, elef kefel migdalim, elef litzoy biraniyyot, elef ushene shilo totafraot; vechol achat veachat havya ketzippori beshalvotah.
Tanya, amar rabbi yose: ani raiti tzippori beshalvotah, vehayu bah mea ushemonim elef shevavkim shel mochre tzike kedera.

"Vehatztzelaot tzela el tzela, shalosh usheloshim peamim" – may "shalosh usheloshim peamim"? amar rabbi levi, amar rav pappe mishshum rabbi yehoshua desichni: im shalosh yerushalayim hen, kol achat veachat yesh bah sheloshim medorin lemala; im sheloshim yerushalayim hen, kol achat veachat yesh bah shelosha medorin lemala.
Ittemar: sefina – rav amar: kevan shemmashach kol shehu – kana. ushemuel amar: lo kana ad sheyyimshoch et kullah.

Lema ketannae – ketzad bimsira? achazah betalpah, bisarah, beukkaf shealeha, bishlif shealeha, bifrumebya shebbefiha, bezog shebbetzavvarah – kenaah. ketzad bimshicha? kore lah vehi baa, o shehikkishah bemakkel veratzta lefanav – kevan sheakra yad varegel, kenaah. rabbi achay veamri la rabbi acha omer: ad shettehallech melo komatah.

Lema rav deamar ketanna kamma ushemuel deamar kerabbi acha? amar lecha rav: ana daamari afillu lerabbi acha – ad kan la kaamar rabbi acha ella bevaale chayyim; deaf al gav deakra yad varegel – beducheta kayyma; aval sefina, kevan denada ba pureta – nada la kullah.

Ushemuel amar: ana daamari afillu ketanna kamma – ad kan la kaamar tanna kamma ella bevaale chayyim, dechevan demiakra yad varegel – iddach lemikar kayyma; aval sefina, i mashech la kulla – in, i la – la.
Lema kehane tannae – detanya: sefina niknet bimshicha. rabbi natan omer: sefina veotiyyot niknot bimshicha

a: Uvishtar.
Otiyyot man dechar shemayyhu? chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: sefina niknet bimshicha, veotiyyot bimsira. rabbi natan omer: sefina veotiyyot niknot bimshicha uvishtar.
Shetar lisfina lema li? mittaltele hi! ella lav hachi katane: sefina niknet bimshicha, veotiyyot bimsira. rabbi natan omer: sefina bimshicha, veotiyyot bishtar?
Sefina bimshicha – hayeynu tanna kamma! ella derav ushemuel ikka benayyhu? la; dechulle alma – i kerav, i kishmuel, uvisfina kulle alma la peligi;
Ki peligi – beotiyyot, vehachi kaamar leh rabbi natan letanna kamma: bisfina – vadday modena lach; beotiyyot – i ikka shetar, in; i la, la.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae – detanya: otiyyot niknot bimsira, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: ben katav velo masar, ben masar vela katav – lo kana, ad sheyyichtov veyimsor.
Bemay okemta – kerabbi? sefina name tikkene bimsira! detanya: sefina niknet bimsira, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: lo kana
b: Ad sheyyimshechenna o ad sheyyiskor et mekomah!
La kashya; kan birshut harabbim, kan besimta.

Bemay okemta leha batrayyta – birshut harabbim? ema sefa – vachachamim omrim: lo kana ad sheyyimshechenna. vei birshut harabbim, mimman agar? vetu, meshicha birshut harabbim mi kanya?! veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mesira kona birshut harabbim, uvechatzer sheenah shel shenehem; meshicha kona besimta, uvechatzer shehi shel shenehem; vehagebaha kona bechol makom!

May "ad sheyyimshechenna" name dekaamar; umay "ad sheyyiskor et mekomah" dekaamar – hachi kaamar: ad sheyyimshechenna mershut harabbim lesimta; veim reshut bealim hi – la kana ad sheyyiskor et mekomah.
Lema abbaye verava – deamri kerabbi?
Amar rav ashe: i deamar leh "lech chazek ukeni" – hachi name; hacha bemay askinan – deamar leh: "lech meshoch ukene";
Mar savar: kefida, umar savar: mare makom hu lo.

Amar rav pappa: hay man dimzabben leh shetara lechavreh, tzarich lemichtav leh: "keni hu – vechol shibuda deveh". amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana, vaamarit leh: tama dichtav leh hachi, ha la ketav leh hachi – la kane?
Vechi latzor al pi tzelochito hu tzarich?! amar li: in; latzor velatzor.

a: Amar ammemar, hilcheta: otiyyot niknot bimsira, kerabbi. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: gemara, o sevara? amar leh: gemara. amar rav ashe: sevara name hu – deotiyyot mille ninhu, umille bemille la mikkanyan.
Vela?! vehaamar rabba bar yitzchak amar rav: shene shetarot hem – "zechu besade lifloni vechitvu lo et hashshetar" – chozer bashshetar, veeno chozer bassade.
"Al menat shettichtevu lo et hashshetar" – chozer ben bashshetar ben bassade.
Verav chiyyay bar avin amar rav huna: shelosha shetarot hen; tere – ha daamaran, iddach – im kadam mocher vechatav et hashshetar.
b: Keotah sheshshaninu: kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen lokeach immo. kevan shehechzik ze bakkarka – nikna shetar bechol makom shehu; vezo hi sheshshaninu: nechasim sheen lahen achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut, bechesef ushetar vachazaka!
Aggav shane; deha matbea – dela nikne bachalifin, veaggav ara nikne.
Ki ha derav pappa havo leh teresar alfe zuze be chozae, akninhu nihaleh lerav shemuel bar acha aggav assippa deveteh. ki ata, nefak leappeh ad tevoch.
Aval lo machar lo et haavadim velo et hammartzufin velo et haantike vechulei. may "antike"? amar rav pappa: iska divgavvav.

Mishna machar et hakkaron – lo machar et happeradot, machar et happeradot – lo machar et hakkaron. machar et hatztzemed – lo machar et habbakar, machar et habbakar – lo machar et hatztzemed. rabbi yehuda omer: haddamim modiin. ketzad? amar lo: "mechor li tzimdach bematayim zuz" – haddavar yadua sheen hatztzemed bematayim zuz. vachachamim omrim: en haddamim reaya.
Gemara tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: machar et hakkaron – machar et happeradot. veha anan "lo machar" tenan! amar leh: ismeyay? amar leh: la, tittargem matnitaych baadukin bo.

Machar et hatztzemed – lo machar et habbakar vechulei. hechi dame? illema dekaru letzimda "tzimda" ulevakar "bakar" – peshita; tzimda zabben leh, bakar la zabben leh! veella dekaru leh name levakar "tzimda"? kulleh zabben leh!

La tzericha, beatra dekaru leh letzimda "tzimda" ulevakar "bakar", veikka name dekaru levakar "tzimda"; rabbi yehuda savar: haddamim modiin, verabbanan savri: en haddamim reaya. vei en haddamim reaya, leheve bittul mikkach!

a: Vechi tema bittul mikkach lerabbanan let lehu, vela?! vehatnan, rabbi yehuda omer: hammocher sefer tora, behema umargalit – en lahen onaa. amru lo: lo amru ella et ellu!
May "en damim reaya" name dekatane – dehave bittul mikkach. veibbaet ema: ki amur rabbanan onaa uvittul mikkach – bichde shehaddaat toa, aval bichde sheen haddaat toa – la; emor mattana yehav leh.

Mishna hammocher et hachamor – lo machar kelav. nachum hammadi omer: machar kelav. rabbi yehuda omer: peamim mechurin, peamim enan mechurin – ketzad? haya chamor lefanav, vechelav alav, veamar lo: "mechor li chamorcha ze" – hare kelav mechurin. "chamorcha hu" – en kelav mechurin.

Gemara amar ulla: machaloket besak vedisakkayya vechumeni – detanna kamma savar: setam chamor lirkov kae, venachum hammadi savar: setam chamor lemassooy kae; aval ukkaf umardaat, kilkeli vachavak – divre hakkol mechurin.

Metivi: "chamor vechelav ani mocher lach" – hare ze machar et haukkaf, veet hammardaat, veet hakkilkeli, veet hachavak. aval lo machar sak, vedisakkayya, vechumeni. uvizman sheamar lo: "hi vechol ma shealeha" – hare kullan mechurin. tama deamar leh: "chamor vechelav" – hu dekane ukkaf umardaat, ha la amar leh hachi – la!
Hu haddin deaf al gav dela amar leh "chamor vechelav" – name ukkaf umardaat mechurin; veha ka mashma lan – deaf al gav daamar leh: "chamor vechelav" – sak vedisakkayya vechumeni la kane.
May "vechumeni"? amar rav pappa bar shemuel: markavta denashe.

Ibbaya lehu: beodan alav machaloket, aval besheenan alav – mode lehu nachum hammadi; o dilma, besheenan alav machaloket, aval beodan alav – modu leh rabbanan lenachum? ta shema: uvizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma shealav" – hare kullan mechurin.
I amrat bishlama beodan alav machloket, ha manni – rabbanan hi. ella i amrat besheen odan alav machloket, aval beodan alav – divre hakkol mechurin; ha manni?
Leolam besheen odan alav machloket, verabbanan hi; veema: uvizman sheamar lo: "hu vechol ma sherauy lihyot alav".
Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: peamim mechurin, peamim sheenan mechurin. may, lav ammay dekaamar tanna kamma kae rabbi yehuda? la, rabbi yehuda
b: Milleta achariti kaamar.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, ta shema: machar et hakkaron – lo machar et happeradot. vetane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: machar et hakkaron – machar et happeradot. vaamar leh: veha anan "lo machar" tenan! vaamar leh: ismeyay? vaamar leh: la, tittargem matnitach baadukim bo.
Mikkelal dematnitin besheen adukim bo; umidderesha besheen odan alav – sefa name besheen odan alav!

Adderabba – ema resha: aval lo machar lo et haavadim velo et haantike. veamrinan, may "antike"? amar rav pappa: iska divgavva. umidderesha beodan alav. sefa name beodan alav! ella tena – mille mille katane.

[Siman: zaggam, nissan] amar abbaye: rabbi eliezer, verabban shimon ben gamliel, verabbi meir, verabbi natan, vesomchos, venachum hammadi – kullehu sevira lehu: ki mezabben inish midde, ihu vechol tashmishteh mezabben.

Rabbi eliezer – ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: hammocher et bet habbad – machar et hakkora. rabban shimon ben gamliel – ditnan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hammocher et hair – machar et hassanter. rabbi meir – detanya, rabbi meir omer: machar et hakkerem – machar tashmishe hakkerem. rabbi natan vesomchos – bitztzit vedugit. nachum hammadi – ha daamaran.
Rabbi yehuda omer: peamim mechurin vechulei. may shena "chamorcha zo", umay shena "chamorcha hu"?

Amar rava: "chamorcha zo" – yada dachamara dideh hu, vehay deka amar leh: "zo" – mishshum kelav kaamar leh. "chamorcha hu" – dela yeda dachamara dideh hu, vehachi kaamar leh: chamorcha hu – shettimkerenna li?

Mishna hammocher et hachamor – machar et hasseyach. machar et happara – lo machar et benah. machar ashpa – machar zivlah. machar bor – machar memeha. machar kavvevret – machar devorim. machar shovach – machar yonim.
Gemara hechi dame? i deamar leh: "hi uvenah" – afillu para uvenah name! i dela amar leh "hi uvenah" – afillu chamor name la!

Amar rav pappa: deamar leh: "chamor menika ufara menika ani mocher lach"; bishlama para – ikka lememar lachalavah bae la; ella chamor – may kaamar leh? shema minna – hi uvenah kaamar leh; veammay kare leh "seyach" – shemmehallech achar sicha naa.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "al ken yomru hammoshlim vegomer"?
"Hammoshlim" – ellu hammoshlim beyitzram. "bou cheshbon" – bou unechashshev cheshbono shel olam; hefsed mitzva keneged secharah, usechar avera keneged hefsedah.

"Tibbane vetikkonen" – im atta ose ken, tibbane baolam hazze vetikkonen laolam habba. "ir sichon" – im mesim adam atzmo keayir ze, shemmehallech achar sicha naa – ma ketiv acharav? "ki esh yatza mecheshbon vegomer" – tetze esh mimmechashshevin, vetochal et sheenan mechashshevin.

"Velehava mikkiryat sichon" – mikkiryat tzaddikim shennikreu "sichin". "achla ar moav" – ze hamehallech achar yitzro, keayir ze shemmehallech achar sicha naa. "baale bamot arnon" – ellu gasse haruach, deamar mar: kol adam sheyyesh bo gassut haruach, nofel begehinnam.
"Vanniram" – amar rasha: en ram, "avad cheshbon" – avad cheshbono shel olam; "ad divon" – amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hameten ad sheyyavo din, "vannashshim

a: Ad nofach" – ad shettavo esh sheenah tzericha nippuach, "ad medva" – ad shettadiv nishmatan. veamri la: ad deaved may devae.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol happoresh middivre tora – esh ochalto, shenneemar: "venatatti [et] panay bahem, mehaesh yatzau vehaesh tochlem".

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yonatan: kol happoresh atzmo middivre tora – nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "adam toe midderech hasekel, bikhal refaim yanuach". veen refaim ella gehinnam – shenneemar: "velo yada ki refaim sham, beimke sheol kerueha.

Machar ashpa – machar zivlah vechulei. tenan hatam: kol harauy lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit; levedek habbayit velo lammizbeach; lo lammizbeach velo levedek habbayit – moalin bahen uvema shebbetochan.
Ketzad? hikdish bor melea mayim; ashpot meleot zevel; shovach male yonim; sade melea asavim; ilan nasuy perot – moalin bahen uvema shebbetochan.

Aval hikdish bor veachar kach nitmalle mayim; ashpa veachar kach nitmallea zevel; shovach veachar kach nitmalle yonim; ilan veachar kach nasa perot; sade veachar kach nitmallea asavim – moalin bahen, veen moalin bema shebbetochan; divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: hikdish et hassade veet hailan – moalin bahen uvegiddulehem, mippene shehen giddule hekdesh.
Tanya, amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda – bevor veshovach, vedivre rabbi yose – besade veilan. hay may? bishlama "nirin divre rabbi yehuda bevor veshovach" – mikkelal diflig assade veilan,
Ella "nirin divre rabbi yose besade veilan" – mikkelal diflig bevor veshovach?! veha rabbi yose "sade veilan" kaamar!

Vechi tema: lidvarav derabbi yehuda kaamar; vehattanya, amar rabbi yose: en ani roe devarav shel rabbi yehuda besade veilan, mippene shehen giddule hekdesh. besade veilan hu deeno roe, ha bevor veshovach – roe!
Hachi kaamar: nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi yose, bevor veshovach – sheaf rabbi yose lo nechlak alav ella besade veilan, aval bevor veshovach mode leh.
Tanu rabbanan: hikdishan rekanin veachar kach nitmalleu – moalin bahen, veen moalin bema shebbetochan. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: af moalin bema shebbetochan.

Amar rabba: machaloket besade veilan – detanna kamma savar la kerabbi yehuda, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar la kerabbi yose; aval bevor veshovach – divre hakkol moalin bahen veen moalin bema shebbetochan.
Amar leh abbaye, veella ha detanya: hikdishan melein – moalin bahen uvema shebbetochan, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon machlif;
b: Vei besade veilan, ammay machlif? ella amar rabba: machaloket bevor veshovach, aval besade veilan – divre hakkol moalin bahen uvema shebbetochan.
Uvevor veshovach – berekanin bemay peligi, uvimlein bemay peligi? berekanin – peligi biflugeta derabbi meir verabbanan;
Detanna kamma savar la kerabbanan, deamri: en adam makne davar shello ba laolam; verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar kerabbi meir, deamar: adam makne davar shello ba laolam.
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi meir – kegon perot dekel, daavidi deatu; hane – mi yemar deatu? amar rava: mashkachat la bemayim habbain derech chatzero labbor, veyonim habbain derech shovacho lashshovach.
Uvimleim bemay peligi? amar rava: kegon shehikdish bor setam; verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar la kaavu, deamar: danin din gavoah middin hedyot,
Ma din hedyot – matze amar: bera zabbeni lach, mayya la zabbeni lach; af din gavoah – bera akdesh, mayya la akdesh. vetanna kamma savar: en danin din gavoah middin hedyot.
Vedin hedyot la?! vehatnan: machar bor – machar memav! amar rava: matnitin yechidaa hi – detanya: machar bor – lo machar memav. rabbi natan omer: machar bor – machar memav.

a: Mishna hallokeach perot shovach mechavero – mafriach bericha rishona. perot kavvevret – notel shelosha nechilim, umesares. challot devash – manniach shete challot. zetim lakotz – manniach shete gerofiyyot.
Gemara vehatanya: bericha rishona usheniyya! amar rav kahana: la kashya; ha la, ha leimma.
May shena imma – demitztavvevta abbarta veazzuga deshavkinan la; ihi name – titztavvavt aimma, veazzuga deshavkinan la! imma abbarta mitztavvevta, beratta aimma la mitztavvevta.

Perot kavvevret – notel shelosha nechilin, umesares. bamme mesarsan? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: bechardal. amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar chanina: lo chardal mesarsan, ella mittoch sheppihen chad – chozrot veochlot et duveshanan.
Rabbi yochanan amar: notel shelosha nechilin – beserus. bematnita tana: notel shelosha nechilin baze achar ze, mikkan veelach – notel achat umanniach achat.
Challot devash – manniach shete challot vechulei. amar rav kahana: devash bechavvevret eno yotze mide maachol leolam. alma kasavar la bae machshava.
Metivi: devash bechavvevret – eno lo ochel velo mashke! amar abbaye: la tzericha ella leotan shete challot. rava amar: derabbi eliezer hi –
b: Ditnan: kavvevret devorim – rabbi eliezer omer: hare hi kakkarka, vechotvin aleha perozbul,
Veenah mekabbelet tumea bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat – chayyayv chattat.
Vachachamim omrim: en kotvin aleha perozbul, veenah kakkarka, umekabbelet tumea bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat – patur.

Amar rabbi elazar: may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv: "vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash" – vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash? ella lomar lach, ma yaar – hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat chayyayv chattat, af devash – harode mimmennu beshabbat chayyayv chattat.
Metivi: devash hazzav mikkavvavrto – eno lo ochel, velo mashke. bishlama leabbaye, nicha;
Ella lerava, kashya! amar rav zevid: kegon shezzav al gabbe keli maus. rav acha bar yaakov amar: kegon shezzav al gabbe kashkashshin.
Metivi: devash bechavvavrto – eno lo ochel velo mashke. chishshev alav laachila – metamme tumeat ochalin. lemashkin – metamme tumeat mashkin. bishlama leabbaye, nicha;
Ella lerava, kashya!

Amar lach rava, taretz hachi: chishshev alav laachila – eno metamme tumeat ochalin, lemashkin – eno metamme tumeat mashkin. tanya kevoteh derav kahana: devash bechavvavrto – metamme tumeat ochalin shello bemachshava.

Zetim lakotz – manniach shete gerofiyyot. tanu rabbanan: hallokeach ilan mechavero lakotz – magbiah min hakkarka tefach, vekotzetz. betulat hashshikma – shelosha tefachim. saddan hashshikma – shene tefachim. bekanim uvigfanim – min happekak ulemala. bidkalim uvaarazim – chofer umesharesh, lefi sheen gizan machlif.
Uvetulat hashshikma shelosha tefachim baenan?! ureminhi: en kotztzin betulat hashshikma bishviit, mippene shehi avoda.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kedarko – asur; ella magbiah asara tefachim vekotzetz, o gomem meim haaretz. meim haaretz hu dekashe, ha iddach mealle la!

Amar abbaye: shelosha tefachim mealle la, meim haaretz vadday kashe la; mikkan veelach – la mikshe kashe la, velav alloye mealle la. gabbe sheviit – avdinan midde devadday kashe lah, gabbe mikkach umimkar – avdinan midde devadday mealle la.

Bidkalim uvaarazim – chofer umesharesh, lefi sheen gizan machlif. veerez en gizo machlif?! veha deresh rabbi chiyyay bar luleyayni, may dichtiv: "tzaddik kattamar yifrach, keerez ballevanon yisge"? im neemar tamar lamma neemar erez, veim neemar erez lamma neemar tamar?
Illu neemar erez velo neemar tamar – hayiti omer: ma erez en ose perot, af tzaddik en ose perot; lechach neemar tamar.
Veim neemar tamar velo neemar erez, hayiti omer: ma tamar en gizo machlif, af tzaddik en gizo machlif; lechach neemar erez!

Ella hacha bemay askinan – bishar mine arazim, kidrabba bar rav huna; deamar rabba bar rav huna, amri be rav: asara mine arazim hen, shenneemar: "etten bammidbar erez, shitta, vahadas; veetz shamen asim vegomer". "erez" – arza. "shitta" – turenita. "hadas" – assa. "etz shemen" – afarsema. "berosh" – berate. "tidhar" – shaga. "uteashshur" – shurebina.
Hane shiva have! ki ata rav dimi amar, hosifu alehen: allonim, almonim, almuggim. allonim – butene, almonim – balute, almuggim –

a: Kesita. ikka deamri: aronim, armonim, almuggim. aronim – are, armonim – duleve, almuggim – kesita.

Mishna hakkone shene ilanot betoch sede chavero – hare ze lo kana karka. rabbi meir omer: kana karka. higdilu – lo yeshappe. vehaole min haggeza – shello; umin hashshorashim – shel baal hakkarka. veim metu – en lo karka.
Kana shelosha – kana karka. higdilu – yeshappe. vehaole min haggeza umin hashshorashin – shello. veim metu – yesh lo karka.
Gemara tenan hatam: hakkone shene ilanot betoch shel chavero – mevi veeno kore. rabbi meir omer: mevi vekore.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mechayyev haya rabbi meir af belokeach perot min hashshuk. mimmay? middekatane mishna yattira – mikkede tena leh deyesh lo karka, peshita demevi vekore.
Ella shema minna, mechayyev haya rabbi meir af belokeach perot min hashshuk.
Veha ketiv: "asher tavi meartzecha"! hahu lemaote chutza laaretz.
Veha ketiv: admatcha! lemaote admat goy. vehachtiv: "asher natatta li"! dihavt li zuze uzevani behu.
Metiv rabba: hakkone ilan echad betoch shel chavero – mevi veeno kore, lefi shello kana karka; divre rabbi meir. teyuveta.
Amar lo rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar:
b: May tama derabbi meir beilan echad, umay tama derabbanan bishne ilanot? amar lo: davar sheharishonim lo amru bo taam, tishaleni bevet hammidrash kede levayyeysheni?
Amar rabba: may kusheya? dilma rabbi meir beilan echad sappoke mesappeka leh, verabbanan bishne ilanot sappoke mesappeka lehu!
Umi mesappeka leh? veha katane: lefi shello kana karka, divre rabbi meir! ema: shemma lo kana karka.
Velechush dedilma lav bikkurim ninhu, veka meayyel chullin laazara! demakdesh lehu. veha bae mechlinhu! defarek lehu. vedilma lav bikkurim ninhu, veka mafka lehu mitteruma umaaser! demafresh lehu.
Bishlama teruma gedola – yahev la lechohen, maaser sheni name – yahev leh lechohen, masar ani name – yahev leh lechohen ani, ella maaser rishon – delevi hu! leman yahev leh?

Deyahev leh lechohen, kerabbi elazar ben azarya – detanya: teruma gedola lechohen, maaser rishon lelevi, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: maaser rishon af lechohen. vedilma bikkurim ninhu, uvau keriyyay! keriyyay lo meakkevet.
Vela?! vehaamar rabbi zera: kol harauy levilla, en billa meakkevet bo; vesheeno rauy levilla, billa meakkevet bo!
Deaved lehu kerabbi yose bar chanina, deamar: betzaran veshiggeran beyad shaliach, umet shaliach badderech – mevi veeno kore. may tama? dichtiv: "velakachta veheveta" –

a: Ad shettehe lekicha vahavaa keechad; veha lekka. amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: mikkede pesuke ninhu, likre!
Amar leh: mishshum demichaze keshikra. rav mesharsheya bereh derav chiyyay amar: dilma ate leafkuinhu mitteruma umaaser.
Higdilu – lo yeshappe kulei. hechi dame min haggeza, vehechi dame min hashshorashin?
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol sheroe pene chamma – zehu min haggeza, vesheeno roe pene chamma – zehu min hashshorashin.
Velechush dilma masseka ara sirton, veamar leh: telata zabbent li, veit li ara! ella amar rav nachman: yakotz. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: yakotz.
Amar rav nachman: nekitinan, dekel en lo geza. savar rav zevid lememar: en lo geza levaal dekel, dechevan dilmichpar ulesharesh kae – assoche massach dateh.
Matkef la rav pappa: veha kone shene ilanot – dilmichpar ulemishrash kayymi, vekatane deyesh lo geza! ella amar rav pappa: en lo geza levaal dekel, lefi sheen motzi geza.
Ulerav zevid, kashya matnitin! dezabben lachamesh shenin.
Kana shelosha – kana karka. vechamma? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hare ze kana tachtehen uvenehen, vechutza lahen
b: Kimlo ore vesallo. matkef la rabbi elazar: hasheta derech en lo, ore vesallo yesh lo?! derech en lo – deara achariti hi; ore vesallo – yesh lo?!
Amar rabbi zera: middivre rabbenu nilmad, shelosha – hu deen lo derech, ha shenayim – yesh lo, deamar leh: beara didach kayymi.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: lema rabbi elazar let leh dishmuel rabbeh – deamar shemuel: halacha kerabbi akiva, deamar: mocher beayin yafa mocher?
Amar leh: la mittokma matnitin kerabbi akiva.
Mimmay? middekatane: higdilu – yeshappe, vei salka datach rabbi akiva hi, ammay yeshappe? haamar: mocher beayin yafa mocher!
Amar leh: emor deamar rabbi akiva – gabbe bor vadut, dela machchashi ara; gabbe ilan mi shamat leh?
Mi la mode rabbi akiva beilan hannote letoch sede chavero, shekkotzetz melo mardea meal gabbe macharesha?
Tanya kevoteh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: hare ze kana tachtehen uvenehen, vechutza lahen kimlo ore vesallo.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: otan ore vesallo, mi zoran? amar leh, tenetuha: hachitzon zorea et hadderech.
Amar leh: mi dame?! hatam let leh peseda lelokeach, aval hacha – it leh peseda lelokeach, daamar leh: kamittannefi pere.
Ha la damya ella lesefa: veze vaze enan rashshain lezorah.
Tanya kevoteh deabbaye: hare ze kana tachtehen uvenehen, vechutza lahen kimlo ore vesallo; veze vaze enan rashshain lezorah.

Vechamma yehe benehen? rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mearba ammot vead shemone. rava amar rav nachman amar shemuel: mishshemone vead shesh esre. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: la tiflog aleh derav nachman, ditnan matnitin kevoteh –
Ditnan: hannotea et karmo shesh esre amma al shesh esre amma, muttar lehavi zera lesham.

Amar rabbi yehuda: maase betzalmon, beechad shennata et karmo shesh esre al shesh esre amma, vehaya hofech sear shete shurot letzad echad, vezorea et hannir; leshana acheret haya hofech et hassear limkom hazzera, vezara et habbur; uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiruhu.
Amar leh: ana la yadana, ella ovada hava

a: Bedura deraavata, vaato lekammeh derav yehuda, vaamar leh: "zil hav leh kimlo bakar vechelav"; vela hava yadana "kimlo bakar vechelav" kamma; kevan deshamita leha ditnan: lo yitta adam ilan samuch lisde chavero, ella im ken hirchik mimmenna arba ammot;
Vetane ala: arba ammot sheamru – kede avodat hakkerem; amena: shema minna, "kimlo bakar vechelav" – arba ammot.
Ucherav yosef mi la tenan?! rabbi meir verabbi shimon omrim: hannotea et karmo shemone ammot al shemone – muttar lehavi zera lesham!
Afillu hachi, maase adif.

Bishlama lerav yosef allibba derabbi shimon – shaminan leh mefuzzarin, veshaminan leh retzufin; mefuzzarin – ha daamaran, retzufin – ditnan: kerem hannatua al pachot mearba ammot – eno kerem, divre rabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim: kerem, veroin et haemtzaiyyim keillu enan.
Ella lerav nachman allibba derabbanan – mefuzzarin shaminan leh; retzufin mi shaminan leh?! sevara hu: middilrabbi shimon palga, lerabbanan name palga.
Amar rava: hilcheta, mearba ammot vead shesh esre. tanya kevoteh derava: kamma yehu mekoravin? arba ammot, vechamma yehu meruchakin? shesh esre.

Hare ze kana karka veet hailanot shebbenehen; lefichach, yavesh hailan o niktzatz – yesh lo karka. pachot mikkan o yater al kan, o shellekachan beze achar ze – hare ze lo kana lo et hakkarka velo et hailanot shebbenehen; lefichach, yavesh hailan o niktzatz – en lo karka.

Bae rabbi yirmeya: keshehu moded, mimmakom katzar hu moded, o mimmakom rachav hu moded? amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe: ta shema, ditnan: harchuva shebbaggefen – eno moded ella meikkar hashsheni.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: machar lo shelosha badde ilan, mahu?

Amar leh rav geviha mibbe chetil lerav ashe: ta shema, ditnan: hammavrich shalosh gefanim, veikkerehen nirin – rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: im yesh benehen mearba ammot vead shemone – mitztarfin, veim lav – en mitztarfin.
Bae rav pappa: machar lo shenayim betoch sadehu veechad al hammetzer, mahu? shenayim betoch shello veechad betoch shel chavero, may? teku.
b: Bae rav ashe: bor, mahu shettafsik? ammat hammayim, mahu shettafsik? reshut harabbim mahu? richba dedikle mahu? teku.
Bea minneh hillel merabbi: ala erez benehen, mahu? "ala"?! birshuta dideh nefak! ella "haya erez benehen, mahu?" amar leh: kana vekana.
Ketzad hen omdim? rav amar: keshura, ushemuel amar: kachatzuva. man deamar keshura – kol shekken kachatzuva; uman deamar kachatzuva – aval keshura la, may tama? mishshum demizdera bentayyhu.

Matkef la rav hamenuna: uleman deamar kachatzuva, may tama – dela mizdera bentayyhu? ella meatta, zabben leh telat hige romayayta, dela mizdera bentayyhu, hachi name deyesh lo karka?! amar leh: hanach la chashivi, hanach chashivi.

Mishna hammocher rosh behema gassa – lo machar et haraglayim, machar et haraglayim – lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane – lo machar et hakkaved, machar et hakkaved – lo machar et hakkane. aval bedakka; machar et harosh – machar et haraglayim, machar et haraglayim – lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane – machar et hakkaved, machar et hakkaved – lo machar et hakkane.

Arba middot bammochrin: machar lo chittin yafot venimtzeu raot – hallokeach yachol lachazor bo. raot venimtzeu yafot – mocher yachol lachazor bo. raot venimtzeu raot; yafot venimtzeu yafot – en echad mehem yachol lachazor bo.

Shechamtit venimtzet levana, levana venimtzet shechamtit; etzim shel zayit venimtzeu shel shikma, shel shikma venimtzeu shel zayit; yayin venimtza chometz, chometz venimtza yayin – shenehem yecholin lachazor bahen.
Gemara amar rav chisda: machar lo shave chamesh – beshesh, vehukar veamad al shemone, mi nitanna? lokeach. lokeach yachol lachazor bo, velo mocher; mishshum

a: Deamar leh: illu la onitan – la hava matzet hadrat bach; hasheta deonitan, matzet hadrat bach?! vetanna tuna: yafot venimtzeu raot – lokeach yachol lachazor bo, velo mocher.

Veamar rav chisda: machar lo shave shesh – bechamesh, vehuzelu veamdu al shalosh, mi nitanna? mocher. mocher yachol lachazor bo, velo lokeach; deamar leh: illu la onitan – la hava matzet hadrat bach; hasheta matzet hadrat bach?! vetanna tuna: raot venimtzeu yafot – mocher yachol lachazor bo, velo lokeach.
May ka mashma lan? matnitin hi! i mimmatnitin, hava amena: dilma derav chisda – tarvayyhu matzu hadri behu, umatnitin ha ata leashmoinan – delokeach yachol lachazor bo.
Desalka datach amena, mishshum dichtiv: "ra ra yomar hakkone".

Shechamtit venimtzet levana kulei. amar rav pappa: middekatane "levana", shema minna hay shimsha summakti hi. teda, deka samka tzafra ufanya. vehay dela ka chazenan kulleh yoma – nehorin hu dela bari.

Metivi: "umarehu amok min haor" – kemare chamma amukka min hatztzel. vehatam lavan hu! kemare chamma – velo kemare chamma; kemare chamma – daamukka min hatztzel, velo kemare chamma – deillu hatam lavan, vehacha adom.
Ulemay dislek datin meikkara – ha ka samka tzafra ufanya! betzafra – dechalfa abbe vavrde degan eden, befanya – dechalfa appitcha degehinnam. veikka deamri ippecha.
Yayin venimtza chometz – shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen. lema matnitin rabbi hi vela rabbanan? detanya:
b: Yayin vachometz – min echad hu. rabbi omer: shene minin. afillu tema rabbanan – ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi ella leinyan maaser uteruma, vechidrabbi illaa –
Deamar rabbi ila: minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa, shetterumato teruma? shenneemar: "velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu".
Im eno kadosh, nesiut chet lamma? mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa, shetterumato teruma.
Aval leinyan mikkach umimkar – dechulle alma ikka denicha leh bechamra vela nicha leh bechalla, veikka denicha leh bechalla vela nicha leh bechamra.
Mishna hammocher perot lachavero, mashach velo madad – kana. madad velo mashach – lo kana. im haya pikkeach – socher et mekoman.
Hallokeach pishtan mechavero – hare ze lo kana, ad sheyyetaltelennu mimmakom lemakom. veim haya mechubbar lakkarka, vetalash kol shehu – kana.
Gemara amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: madad vehinniach al gabbe simta, kana.
Amar lo rabbi zera lerabbi assi: shemma lo shama rabbi ella bemoded letoch kuppato? amar leh: dame hay merabbanan kidla gamri inashe shemata. madad letoch kuppato – memra bae?!
Kaybla minneh, o la kaybla minneh? ta shema, deamar rabbi yannay amar rabbi: chatzar hashshuttafin – konin ze mizze. may, lav al gabbe karka? lo, letoch kuppato.

Hachi name mistabbera, deamar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: madad vehinniach al gabbe simta – lo kana. kashyayn ahadade! ella lav shema minna kan bemoded letoch kuppato, kan bemoded al gabbe karka? shema minna.
Ta shema: madad velo mashach – lo kana. may, lav besimta? lo, birshut harabbim. i hachi, ema resha: mashach velo madad – kana. meshicha birshut harabbim mi kanya?!
Veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mesira kona birshut harabbim uvechatzer sheenah shel shenehen; meshicha kona besimta uvechatzer shehi shel shenehen; vehagebaha kona bechol makom!

May "mashach" name dekatane – mershut harabbim lesimta. i hachi, ema sefa: im haya pikkeach – socher et mekoman. vei birshut harabbim, mimman agar? hachi kaamar: veim birshut bealim hi, im haya pikkeach – socher et mekoman.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu:

a: Kilyo shel adam kone lo bechol makom, chutz mershut harabbim. verabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayyhu: afillu birshut harabbim.
Amar rav pappa: la peligi; kan birshut harabbim, kan besimta. veammay karu la reshut harabbim? sheen reshut hayyachid.
Hachi name mistabbera, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kilyo shel adam kone lo bechol makom sheyyesh lo reshut lehannicho. yesh lo reshut – in, en lo reshut – la. shema minna.

Ta shema, arba middot bammochrin: ad shello nitmallea midda – lammocher, mishshennitmallea midda – lallokeach. bamme devarim amurim – bemidda sheenah shel shenehen, aval im hayta midda shel echad mehen – rishon rishon – kana.

Bamme devarim amurim – birshut harabbim uvechatzer sheenah shel shenehen, aval birshut mocher – lo kana ad sheyyagbihenna o ad sheyyotzienna mershuto. birshut lokeach – kevan shekkibbel alav mocher, kana lokeach. birshut halla hammufekadim etzlo – lo kana ad sheyyekabbel alav, o ad sheyyiskor et mekoman.
Katane miha, birshut harabbim uvechatzer sheenah shel shenehen;
b: May, lav birshut harabbim mammash? la; simta. veha dumeya dechatzer sheenah shel shenehem katane!
May "chatzer sheenah shel shenehem" name – dela dehay kullah vela dehay kullah; ella detarvayyhu.
Bea minneh rav sheshet merav huna: kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher – kana lokeach, o la? amar leh, tenetuha: zerako lah letoch chekah o letoch kaltah – hare zo megoreshet.
Amar leh rav nachman: may tama pashtat leh mehahi, demachu la mea uchele beuchela?

Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu shehayta kaltah teluya bah. veresh lakish amar: keshura, veaf al pi sheenah teluya ba. rav adda bar ahava amar: kegon shehayta kaltah munnachat lah ben yarchoteha. rav mesharsheya bereh derabbi amme amar: kegon shehaya balah mocher kelatot.
Rabbi yochanan amar: mekom chekah kanuy lah, mekom kaltah kanuy lah. amar rava: may tama derabbi yochanan? lefi sheen adam makpid lo al mekom chekah velo al mekom kaltah.
Ella peshot lah meha: birshut mocher – lo kana ad sheyyagbihenna o ad sheyyotzienna mershuto. may, lav bechilyo delokeach? lo, bechilyo democher.

Umidderesha bechilyo democher – sefa name bechilyo democher; ema sefa: birshut lokeach, kevan shekkibbel alav mocher – kana lokeach. vei bechilyo democher, ammay kana lokeach? sefa atan lechilyo delokeach.
Umay paska? setama demilleta, be mocher – mane democher shechichi, be lokeach – mane delokeach shechichi.
Amar rava, ta shema: mashach chamarav ufoalav, vehichnisan letoch beto; ben pasak ad shello madad, uven madad ad shello pasak – shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen.

a: Perkan vehichnisan letoch beto; pasak ad shello madad – en shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen, madad ad shello pasak – shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen. umiddechilyo democher birshut lokeach – lo kana, kilyo delokeach name – birshut mocher lo kana!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: besheshshefachan. ikkefad rava – midde "shefachan" katane?! "perkan" katane! ella amar mar bar rav ashe: bimtakkele detume.
Amar leh huna bereh demar zutera leravina: mikkede "perkan" katane; ma li pasak uma li lo pasak? amar leh: pasak – samcha dateh, lo pasak – la samcha dateh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ta shema, derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kilyo shel adam kone lo bechol makom. leetoye may? lav leetoye reshut mocher? hatam, deamar leh: zil keni.

Tenan hatam: nechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut – niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vesheen lahen achrayut – en niknin ella bimshicha. besura matnu la leha shemata mishshemeh derav chisda; befumebdita matnu la mishshemeh derav kahana, veamri la mishshemeh derava: lo shanu ella devarim sheen darkan lehagebiah, aval devarim sheddarkan lehagebiah – behagebaha in, bimshicha la.
Yetev abbaye vekaamar leha shemata; etiveh rav adda bar matna leabbaye: haggonev kis beshabbat – chayyayv, shekkevar nitchayyev bigneva kodem sheyyavo lide issur shabbat.
Haya megarer veyotze megarer veyotze – patur, shehare issur shabbat ugeneva bain keechad.
Vahare kis – devar hagebaha hu, vaafillu hachi kane bimshicha! amar leh: bemitna. ana name bemitna ka amena! amar leh: bemidde devae mitna.

Ta shema: birshut mocher – lo kana ad sheyyagbihenna, o ad sheyyotzienna mershuto. alma, midde devar hagebaha – i bae behagebaha kane leh, vei bae bimshicha kane leh! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: litzdadin katane – midde devar hagebaha, behagebaha; midde devar meshicha, bimshicha.
b: Ta shema: hammocher perot lachavero, mashach velo madad – kane. veha perot, divne hagebaha ninhu, vekatane dekane bimshicha!

Hacha bemay askinan – bishlife ravreve. i hachi, ema sefa: hallokeach pishtan mechavero – lo kana ad sheyyetaltelennu mimmakom ze lemakom acher. attu pishtan bishlife ravreve mi la avdi?! shane pishtan – demishtemit.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, ta shema: behema gassa niknet bimsira, vehaddakka – behagebaha; divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon ben elazar. vachachamim omrim: behema dakka – bimshicha. veha behema dakka, devar hagebaha hi, vekatane dekane bimshicha! shane behema, desarcha.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: "kor bishloshim ani mocher lach" – yachol lachazor bo, afillu bisa haacharona. "kor bishloshim – sea besela ani mocher lach" – rishon rishon kana.
Ta shema: im hayta midda shel echad mehen – rishon rishon kana. veaf al gav delo nitmallea hammidda!
Kegon daamar leh: "hin bishnem asar selaim – log besela ani mocher lach"; vechidamar rav kahana: shenatot hayu bahin, hacha name – shenatot hayu bammiddot.
Ta shema: hassocher et happoel laasot immo laggoren hayyom bedinar,
